status: Observed local functional baseline, not complete competitor parity

grading.policy: Full requires complete researched target and acceptance through model, commands, editor and compiled/exported runtime where relevant, plus actual observed execution. Significant missing target subfeatures make a row partial. Unknown competitor evidence is never counted as absence.

features.target: Page create/rename/duplicate/delete with unique normalized routes.
features.acceptance: Create two routes; export serves both at their exact paths.
features.limitation: Pages add, rename, delete and export routes. No page duplication command or control.

features.target: Stable node IDs, tree panel and nested canvas selection.
features.acceptance: Select parent/child and retain focus across property updates.
features.limitation: Nested ids and selection, keyed inspector and iframe updates are implemented.

features.target: Node movement with ancestor-cycle and ownership validation.
features.acceptance: Reparent valid node; reject moving parent into descendant.
features.limitation: Reparent and sibling ordering are validated; descendant-cycle changes are rejected.

features.target: Rust styles compile to flex direction, alignment, gap and wrapping.
features.acceptance: Export horizontal/vertical stacks at desktop and phone.
features.limitation: Direction, gap and alignment edit flex layout; inspector does not expose wrapping.

features.target: Columns, rows, gaps, child placement and responsive overrides.
features.acceptance: Export a two-column grid with phone override.
features.limitation: Columns and gaps plus narrow overrides are editable. Row tracks and child placement lack controls.

features.target: Isolated iframe showing compiled site runtime.
features.acceptance: Preview renders links and interactions without selection boxes.
features.limitation: Preview hides selection and routes links, but uses a separate TypeScript renderer instead of the compiled runtime; forms and scroll behavior diverge.

features.target: History of validated document operations.
features.acceptance: Undo an edit and redo it after serialization round trip.
features.limitation: Atomic undo/redo snapshots work during a session. Loading a serialized site clears history.

features.target: Explicit deterministic cascade, custom widths and reset overrides.
features.acceptance: Base change propagates until locally overridden.
features.limitation: Base, tablet and mobile cascade and reset exist. Custom preview width does not create or edit a saved breakpoint definition.

features.target: Font sizing, leading and spacing overrides.
features.acceptance: Viewport checks show intended typography at two widths.
features.limitation: Font size, line height and letter spacing support narrower breakpoint overrides.

features.target: Per-breakpoint visibility in compiled CSS.
features.acceptance: Hidden phone-only/desktop-only nodes obey media queries.
features.limitation: Breakpoint display:none is editable and compiles to media queries.

features.target: Typed tokens and references resolved to CSS custom properties.
features.acceptance: Token change updates every reference without duplicating values.
features.limitation: Shared CSS custom properties update references. Tokens are untyped strings.

features.target: Named text presets with semantic tag separate from visual style.
features.acceptance: Update body preset and compile both text nodes consistently.
features.limitation: No named text-preset model, command or editor workflow.

features.target: Definition IDs, instances, detachable content.
features.acceptance: Edit definition and verify multiple instances change.
features.limitation: Capture and insert linked definitions propagate content/style edits. No detachment; source structure locks after insertion.

features.target: Typed exposed props with local override and reset.
features.acceptance: Two instances share layout while preserving unique labels.
features.limitation: Category-level instance overrides preserve local edits. No typed exposed properties or reset operation.

features.target: Named states with inherited style overrides.
features.acceptance: Switch default/secondary variant; reset to inherited base.
features.limitation: No component variant/state model or switching controls.

features.target: Typed named content slots.
features.acceptance: Fill two component slots without mutating definition.
features.limitation: No named component-slot descriptors or slot insertion workflow.

features.target: Versioned library manifests and update review.
features.acceptance: Import a library with pinned version; handle local detach.
features.limitation: No pinned cross-project library manifests or update review.

features.target: SQLite collections with schema-driven validation.
features.acceptance: Reject wrong field types and persist valid items.
features.limitation: Six scalar field types are validated and saved in SQLite-backed project documents; CMS UI creates schemas and items.

features.target: Generate one route per published item from a template.
features.acceptance: Two items compile to different populated URLs.
features.limitation: No CMS template-page model or per-item route generation.

features.target: Explicit binding descriptors including text, image and URL.
features.acceptance: Export node content from a selected collection item.
features.limitation: Text and image bindings render both editor and export. No URL-attribute or explicit selected-item binding descriptor.

features.target: Repeated templates with an empty-state subtree.
features.acceptance: A zero-item filter renders only its empty state.
features.limitation: Published items repeat in editor and export. No empty-state subtree or filter model.

features.target: Typed predicates; optional runtime visitor controls.
features.acceptance: Filter on text/number/date; preserve stable ordering.
features.limitation: No collection predicate/query model or visitor filter controls.

features.target: Deterministic sort, offset/cursor, limits.
features.acceptance: Filter then paginate with no duplicates or missing items.
features.limitation: No collection sort or pagination descriptors/runtime.

features.target: CSV mapping, slug conflict reports and complete CSV export.
features.acceptance: Import quoted comma/newline values and export them correctly.
features.limitation: No CMS CSV mapping, import or export operation.

features.target: References and multireferences with missing target diagnostics.
features.acceptance: Resolve related author; detect removed or cross-collection reference.
features.limitation: No reference or multi-reference field type/resolution.

features.target: Draft/published/archived states; only published items export by default.
features.acceptance: Draft record remains stored but absent from published routes.
features.limitation: Model validates draft/published/archived and compiler omits non-published items. Editor exposes only draft/published.

features.target: Declarative hover/focus/press CSS with reduced-motion fallback.
features.acceptance: Preview button state on pointer and keyboard focus.
features.limitation: Hover runtime includes focus and reduced motion; no declarative press state and editor preview lacks runtime parity.

features.target: Observer-triggered WAAPI runtime with saved timing/easing.
features.acceptance: Reveal once; respects prefers-reduced-motion.
features.limitation: Export reveals on IntersectionObserver with reduced-motion fallback and saved duration. No authorable easing; preview lacks scroll execution.

features.target: Event-to-component-state actions.
features.acceptance: Toggle menu from closed to open and back in exported site.
features.limitation: Generic toggle-class is implemented, but no component states or event-to-variant transition.

features.target: Timeline tracks, delays, overlap, easing and targets.
features.acceptance: Two tracks run with prescribed delay/overlap.
features.limitation: No timeline tracks, overlap, delay/easing editor or multi-target sequencer.

features.target: Conditions with explicit session storage and overlay focus management.
features.acceptance: Query predicate opens accessible dismissible overlay.
features.limitation: No behavior predicates, persisted overlay sessions or accessible site-overlay runtime.

features.target: Accessible fields, server validation and schema constraints.
features.acceptance: Required email rejects invalid payload before persistence.
features.limitation: Preset contact form and required/email/numeric server checks work. General field types and constraints are incompletely exposed/validated.

features.target: Local submissions persisted with export and retention.
features.acceptance: Submit live form; view stored payload and export CSV.
features.limitation: Submissions persist and are listable through API/MCP. No editor inbox, CSV export or retention controls.

features.target: Durable delivery jobs, signed payloads, retry schedule.
features.acceptance: Fixture endpoint receives signed body; failure records retry.
features.limitation: No durable signed webhook delivery jobs or retry pipeline.

features.target: Inline pending/success/error and safe redirect target.
features.acceptance: Real submit updates status and retains values on error.
features.limitation: Export runtime renders pending/success/error and preserves error values. No configured success redirect; editor preview blocks submission.

features.target: Rate limiting, bounded payload, honeypot and optional provider adapter.
features.acceptance: Abuse fixture is rejected without affecting valid submissions.
features.limitation: Server rate limit, bounded request parsing and honeypot rejection are implemented for live exported forms.

features.target: Hidden attribution with explicit query binding.
features.acceptance: Submitted data includes named hidden field only when enabled.
features.limitation: Generic hidden input fields can be represented and submitted. No explicit query-attribution binding/control.

features.target: Locale records, fallback and per-node text/asset overrides.
features.acceptance: Two locales export different text with correct fallback.
features.limitation: Locale text dictionaries and metadata overrides fall back. No localized asset overrides.

features.target: Per-item translated fields and locale publication state.
features.acceptance: One item exports locale-aware routes and translated content.
features.limitation: CMS item values and publication status are global, not locale-specific.

features.target: Locale-aware lang, alternates, slug uniqueness and canonical links.
features.acceptance: HTML contains valid lang and reciprocal hreflang URLs.
features.limitation: Selected locale sets lang and canonical. No reciprocal hreflang, locale routes or slug overrides.

features.target: Provider interface with review state and explicit configured credentials.
features.acceptance: Configured provider returns translations queued for review.
features.limitation: No configured translation provider, review state or translation queue.

features.target: Titles, descriptions, canonical, Open Graph and binding templates.
features.acceptance: Export two item pages with different SEO metadata.
features.limitation: Page title/description/canonical/Open Graph compile. No per-item SEO binding/templates.

features.target: Published route sitemap, exclusions and configured public origin.
features.acceptance: Draft/noindex routes absent; XML escapes and absolute URLs valid.
features.limitation: Sitemap excludes noindex pages, robots is emitted and the configured public origin now compiles. No public-origin editor control.

features.target: Validated HTTP redirect manifest and redirect cycle detection.
features.acceptance: Old route returns chosen status/Location; loop rejected.
features.limitation: No redirect rules, response adapter or cycle detection.

features.target: Semantic tags, decorative image option and explicit label associations.
features.acceptance: Export contains meaningful semantics and accessible form names.
features.limitation: Semantic tags, decorative empty-alt and explicit aria-label names are editable and compile; label-for also works through the model.

features.target: Deterministic diagnostics with node/page IDs and severity.
features.acceptance: Missing alt/title issue points to exact node/page.
features.limitation: Deterministic severity/node diagnostics exist. Missing page title/description issues do not expose exact page ids.

features.target: JSON-LD editor and script-safe JSON serialization.
features.acceptance: Valid JSON-LD emits without allowing script termination.
features.limitation: No JSON-LD editor/model or compiler emission.

features.target: Compile immutable release snapshots and preview paths.
features.acceptance: Later edits do not mutate a previously built release.
features.limitation: Publish writes versioned immutable local snapshots and exposes a preview link.

features.target: Atomic active release pointer and rollback to prior release.
features.acceptance: Promotion serves selected release; rollback restores exact bytes.
features.limitation: No active production release pointer, promotion or rollback.

features.target: Deployment adapters; domain proof/TLS/CDN require infrastructure.
features.acceptance: Report local export versus verified remote deploy separately.
features.limitation: Local publishing only; no remote deploy/domain/TLS/CDN adapter.

features.target: Isolated snapshots with revision-aware merge/conflict reports.
features.acceptance: Overlapping edits report conflicts; reviewed branch can apply.
features.limitation: No isolated branch model, review workflow or revision-aware branch merge.

features.target: Node-anchored comments and server-enforced project roles.
features.acceptance: Viewer cannot mutate document; comment anchor survives reorder.
features.limitation: No node comments or project role system; optional shared token is not a role.

features.target: Presence stream, optimistic concurrency and eventual conflict policy.
features.acceptance: Two-session concurrent edit either merges safely or conflicts.
features.limitation: SSE updates and expectedRevision conflicts exist. No person/session presence or multiplayer merge policy.

features.target: FastAPI routes with typed schemas and revision conflicts.
features.acceptance: REST update persists via Rust command; stale revision returns conflict.
features.limitation: Typed REST schemas, optional bearer/cookie auth and revision-aware Rust mutation/persistence are implemented. No saved-project delete API, store operation or editor control; complete project CRUD remains partial.

features.target: Protocol lifecycle, discovery, tools/call and read-only project resources.
features.acceptance: Independent MCP client discovers tools and mutates project; output matches saved state.
features.limitation: Official MCP SDK implements lifecycle, tools/resources and the same document authority; Agents UI controls access.

features.target: Same role checks for REST/MCP and attributed operation audit.
features.acceptance: Unauthorized MCP mutation rejected and successful mutation attributed.
features.limitation: Agent on/off and optional shared token restrict REST/MCP. No role scopes or attributed operation audit trail.

features.target: Opt-in isolated component build pipeline with typed prop descriptors.
features.acceptance: Component prop edits render in preview/export and errors are surfaced.
features.limitation: No isolated code-component build/import or typed code-component props/export.

features.target: Controlled fetch descriptor with loading/error state and server secret proxy.
features.acceptance: Configured fixture updates data without exposing server credentials.
features.limitation: No external fetch descriptors, loading/error states or credential proxy.

features.target: Complete owned static HTML/CSS/assets/runtime with manifest.
features.acceptance: Serve exported folder independently; all local routes/assets resolve.
features.limitation: Owned raster assets, HTML/CSS/runtime, route files and source JSON export portably; the MCP response includes the emitted file manifest. Remote media remain declared external references.

features.target: Materialized published CMS pages across configured locales.
features.acceptance: Portable export contains CMS entries and locale alternates.
features.limitation: Published CMS lists and one selected locale materialize. No per-item detail pages or locale alternate routes in a single archive.

features.target: Versioned FormWeb JSON archive containing assets/references.
features.acceptance: Reimport exported project and compare canonical content/hash.
features.limitation: Versioned .fweb archives embed referenced owned raster images with hashes and restore the canonical model and exact image bytes into clean data.

features.target: Commerce provider adapters; catalog preview not equivalent to payment backend.
features.acceptance: Configured provider product/variant sync reports truthful availability.
features.limitation: No commerce provider/catalog/variant/inventory adapter.

features.target: Provider hosted checkout and order webhooks, no fabricated checkout.
features.acceptance: Sandbox checkout and signed webhook verify actual order transition.
features.limitation: No live cart, checkout provider, shipping/tax/order webhook pipeline.

features.target: Optional provider integration or separately scoped authentication module.
features.acceptance: Distinguish editor account security from visitor membership functionality.
features.limitation: No visitor account/gated-content provider. Editor access tokens are unrelated.

features.target: Explicit consent/config, event schema and experiment assignment.
features.acceptance: Event collection is real; dashboard uses collected metrics.
features.limitation: No analytics event collection, consent schema, experiment assignment or metrics dashboard.

scope_note: This is attainment against the selected 65-row union of researched capability targets, including FormWeb portability differentiators. It is not a measured percentage of all Framer or Webflow functionality. Competitor unknown/integration/retired/native-not-offered entries remain distinct.

Valid cross-parent node movement

Actual production editor Chromium 153 under CPU 4x, network latency 150 ms / 750 kbps and disabled cache. Cold reload connected Rust without page errors; canvas showed three published CMS cards. Headline inspector edit persisted and retained H1 DOM identity. Undo/redo passed after acknowledged state. Save at revision 6 passed. Mobile color override and width 390 differed from desktop base at width 1280. About /about/team created. Individual controls beyond this shared-handler sample were source-inspected rather than each independently clicked.

Actual editor created About /about/team with a heading and component, and Parent container moved the instance into a Section with matching Rust children. CMS dialog created Services fields title:text and summary:text and saved a published consulting item. Locales dialog created fr and saved headline/home.title translations. Agents off produced MCP 403, then on restored access. During a focused pending Text value with selection 3..10, an independent description update arrived through SSE: input DOM identity, focus, pending text and selection survived; iframe/sidebar/inspector removal count stayed zero.

Actual image chooser uploaded a valid 96x64 PNG, inserted its Rust node and decoded it in the canvas at 96x64. Native .fweb embedded one raster. Export UI produced a nine-file ZIP with nested about/team route and exact PNG bytes. Publish UI produced an immutable version; published root heading and 96x64 image rendered, and nested about/team returned HTTP 200. The first one-pixel fixture was rejected by Chromium before HTTP upload; this failed fixture was not counted as successful browser image verification.

New UI produced a fresh unique site id. Importing the previously downloaded .fweb through the actual editor restored canonical model equality and rendered the owned image at 96x64. This browser round trip supplements the independent clean-data image restore in OBS-024.

Latest production bundle Design controls set Mobile font size 40px and Display none; iframe computed values were font-size 40px and display none. Export waited for the edits and ZIP CSS contained the mobile override under @media(max-width:767px). Clear breakpoint overrides restored an empty node.breakpoints object. Theme light persisted a cold reload, then reset to dark. Preview removed every selection attribute. Audit dialog displayed three real findings with Select controls. Browser pageerror remained empty.

Official SDK stdio_client and ClientSession initialized setup/mcp_stdio.py, discovered ten tools and two resources, read get_site and applied a revision-aware headline change through stdio; REST state matched the mutation. HTTP independent client is separately recorded in OBS-012.

limitations_of_verification: The full researched acceptance scope is stricter than a successful primitive command; significant missing subfeatures remain partial.
Native browser interactions and live form status UI are source inspected; automated end-to-end acceptance of every interaction, input type, viewport and screen reader was not claimed.
Remote hosting, external commerce, translation-provider and third-party service integrations were not configured or exercised.
Source-only boundary rows identify absent models/commands/editor/runtime, not competitor absence.
Root browser follow-ups are summarized in docs/VERIFICATION.md; raw temporary runtime stores are not part of the shipped repository.
